text:
Sam (Sales): Quick shoutout — VelvetPay has renewed their Dedicated commitment and published their Redwood-powered integration as an ISV listing on the Azure Marketplace. Huge win for partnership and revenue retention :tada:
Riley (Solutions): Incredible. They moved live traffic to their dedicated cluster yesterday, routing fraud-scorer inference through our quantized model. Saw 3x reduction in per-token cost in initial reports.
Mira (Product): Tech highlights we shipped: 4-bit quantization profile, prefix KV caching for session pins, and a routing policy that pins EU traffic to eu-west for latency compliance.
Jorge (Customer Success): Onboarding plan: kickoff with VelvetPay on Mon, run M-P1 health checks, delivery runbook, and a 30-day QPS ramp. I've scheduled the kickoff for 1796507900.
Alex (BizDev): Marketing ask — can we get a short customer quote for the announcement and a 1-paragraph case blurb? I can draft press/email once we have permission.
Sam (Sales): VelvetPay CTO sent an approved line: \"Redwood made inference for our fraud model predictable and materially cheaper — it unlocked our ability to ship in production.\" I'll attach the signed permission after legal confirms.
Riley (Solutions): Internal docs: https://internal.redwood/partnerships/velvetpay-integration (contains topology diagram, routing policy, and perf traces).
Mira (Product): Deployment note for SREs: if customer uses customer-managed KMS, ensure the IAM role mapping includes the KMS key policy — sample snippet pasted below:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE"
    }
  ]
}
```
Alex (BizDev): I'll coordinate the blog + case study with product and CS. @Mira @Jorge please confirm the short technical blurb and a customer quote by EOD Thursday.
Jorge (Customer Success): Confirmed — quote approval expected by tomorrow. Onboarding checklist ready.
announce-bot: :mega: Partnership update posted to #announcements and company newsletter queue.
Sam (Sales): Fantastic work team — big thanks to Solutions and CS for the fast turn. :clap:
